Name: Sweet Art Resources
Author: Kyuya258369
Description:
这是一些我在过往的这段时间绘制的贴图素材的一部分，原属于我很久之前最早发布在贴吧的糖果谷mod（虽然经过几次迭代已经差不多完全变样了）。
These are some of the texture materials I have drawn in the past, originally belonging to the Candy Valley mod that I first released in the Tieba a long time ago (although it has almost completely changed after several iterations).

因为之前撤掉了链接但很多人又想要，所以现在我上传到了N网。除此之外还有一些单独作为一个mod发出来内容太少但比较完整的美化。（都是很久很久之前绘制的了）
Because I removed the link before but many people wanted it again, I have now uploaded it to Nexus. In addition, there are also some complete beautification with too little content posted as a single mod. (It was all drawn a long, long time ago)

因为东西太多太杂所以我没办法做成一个写好文件的mod，所以就作为美术资源发布了。
I couldn't create a well written mod because there were too many and miscellaneous things, so I published it as an art resource.

[b][color=#ff7700]私下自己个人使用不做限制，允许作为模组美术资源进行二次改动，但上传时请注明我的名字以及我的发布地址。
[/color][/b][b][color=#ff7700]Private personal use is not restricted, and secondary modifications are allowed as a module art resource. However, please indicate my name and publishing address when uploading.
[/color][/b][b][color=#ff7700]
但无论如何我禁止以任何名义的付费二次分享，涉及自愿打赏项目请联系我单独索要授权，因为我需要知道你拿去干了什么。[/color][/b][b][color=#ff7700]But in any case, I prohibit paying for secondary sharing under any name. If there is a voluntary reward project involved, please contact me separately to request authorization, as I need to know what you have done with it.
